format: 1920×1080 H.264, 30 fps, AAC stereo, MP4 faststart
method: Real deployed browser sessions; no API interception. Validated action/result scenes from multiple takes. Actions at real speed, navigation/loading between scenes trimmed; brief final-frame holds permit caption reading. Browser music output captured through MediaRecorder and aligned on recording timestamps.

limits: Catalogue creation/editing/deletion and account role changes previewed or canceled; existing records preserved.
No production email relay: recovery unavailability and invalid reset links shown, rather than a fabricated successful email.
History and notification paging require sufficient retained data; current synthetic accounts do not meet that threshold.
Mobile web demonstrated, not a native application.
Scope is recorded product workflows, not exhaustive load or device certification.
Native browser/OS notification prompts and alerts are not filmed; live in-app delivery, read, dismissal and destinations are demonstrated.
